mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT b.tech_pack_id AS pack_id, s.color_id FROM tp_bom_item_sku s JOIN tp_bom_item b ON b.id = s.bom_item_id WHERE b.tech_pack_id IN #{id} AND s.color_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pack_id, s.color_id

SELECT b.tech_pack_id AS pack_id, s.size_code FROM tp_bom_item_size s JOIN tp_bom_item b ON b.id = s.bom_item_id WHERE b.tech_pack_id IN #{id} UNION SELECT b.tech_pack_id AS pack_id, s.size_code FROM tp_bom_item_sku s JOIN tp_bom_item b ON b.id = s.bom_item_id WHERE b.tech_pack_id IN #{id} AND s.size_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pack_id, size_code
